items.title: Ray Conniff interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: my parents played Glenn Miller and a little Basie

ctx.x: Ray currently lives in Los Angeles, and was interviewed in San Diego, California on February 14, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.

We are filming in San Diego for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. And I am honored to have Mr. Ray Conniff with me — trombonist and arranger and composer. And I want to tell you that when I grew up, in the 50s, I lived outside Rochester, New York, and it was kind of a typical suburban home, and in my house, my parents played Glenn Miller and a little Basie, and a lot of Ray Conniff. So it’s a real pleasure for me to be talking with you today, because your sound is something that was present a lot as I grew up. I…
